operations.previousValue: Start with your own product photo and a short brief. Save an editable draft, shape its storyboard and generate only the shots you choose before assembling and downloading the video.
operations.value: Six clear steps. One editable workflow, from your product details to the final video.

previousValue.d: Upload a clear product photo or import a public product page. Review the photos, features and product details you want to use, so your video starts with information about your own product.

Browse scene templates for product demonstrations, close-ups and presenter introductions. Preview the creative direction and choose an available AI presenter when your video needs someone to explain the product.
Describe who the product is for, what it does and the message you want viewers to remember. Set an available aspect ratio and duration to suit your product page or social channel.
Save an editable draft in your Library, then generate its storyboard. Review the sequence and refine the visuals and dialogue for each shot before you decide which shots to create.
previousValue.t: Save your draft and refine the storyboard

previousValue.d: Review the credit estimate and generate the shots you choose. Compare versions, select your preferred clips and assemble them into a video. Check any supported captions alongside the visuals and dialogue.
